req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-003 requires GET /players/{playerId} to return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given UUID. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known UUID returns 200, (2) a negative case confirming a well-formed but non-existent UUID returns exactly 404, (3) a boundary case using a nil UUID (all-zeros) which is guaranteed absent, (4) a decision-table case confirming a malformed non-UUID string returns 422 (not 404), distinguishing the two error branches in the route. Each test asserts the exact status code constant to catch comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200
trace: R-PLAYER-003: positive path — existing player must NOT return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200():
    known_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{known_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == known_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'

tests.name: test_get_player_404_response_for_random_valid_uuid
preconditions: A freshly generated UUID v4 is astronomically unlikely to collide with any seeded row
trace: R-PLAYER-003: error pathway — any valid UUID not in the database must return exactly 404; catches constant-mutation on status code 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_404_response_for_random_valid_uuid():
    fresh_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    r = client.get(f'/players/{fresh_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_get_existing_player_last_seeded_row_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: Player with id '77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8' (squad 26, last row) exists
trace: R-PLAYER-003: boundary — last seeded row must return 200, not 404; catches off-by-one or inverted condition mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_existing_player_last_seeded_row_returns_200_not_404():
    last_id = '77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{last_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == last_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 26
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Aditya'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Mehta'
